{{Quote|Her father is an influential local official on Saccoria.|Devidia's bounty posting mentions her father|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] local '''official''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]] was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Devidia Vennsiol]]. When Devidia was a child, he allowed her to do as she pleased with little consequence, spoiling and pampering her. She quickly learned to control boys with her looks and charisma, which drove her father to his wit's end, and resulted in him sending her to [[Unidentified military school|military school]] as a teenager. Devidia learned little at the school though, and her attitude did not improve. She eventually broke into a [[Safidine Industries]] [[Unidentified Safidine Industries laboratory|laboratory]] with her boyfriend [[Dorbus Kyrullus]] and they stole several prototype [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], resulting in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being placed on her head.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The official was first mentioned in the "[[Bounties to Die For]]" article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series. The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and the official was included in an entry for Devidia Vennsiol, which was written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]].<ref name="BTDF" />
